attributes.name: Blessing of Baalzebul
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any check.

Discard this card to add 2 dice to any check that is not a check to acquire or defeat.

Discard this card to explore your location. If this card has the Corrupted trait, during this exploration, the difficulty of all checks is increased by 1d6.

After you play this card, if the top card of the blessings discard pile has the Corrupted trait, recharge this card instead of discarding it.
